title: On the classification of threefold flops
summary: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities.
